description: This PHP class defines the entity 'ClaimRequest' for an HRM system, representing claim requests made by employees. It includes properties like employee, user, claim event, status, and timestamps, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: ClaimRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim request with properties for employee, user, claim event, reference ID, description, currency, status, and timestamps, using Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the claim request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the claim request.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated employee.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the associated employee.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user who added the claim.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user who added the claim.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Returns the reference ID for the claim.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID for the claim.

methods.name: getClaimEvent
methods.description: Returns the claim event associated with the claim request.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Sets the claim event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the claim request.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the claim request.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Returns the currency type.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Sets the currency type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the claim request is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deletion status of the claim request.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the claim request.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the claim request.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the claim request.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Returns the submission date if available.

methods.name: setSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets the submission date.
